root_cause.text: The `sev_ioctl_do_pek_csr()` function omitted an error check after the PSP firmware command (`SEV_CMD_PEK_CSR`) failed, allowing a `copy_to_user()` of the CSR blob using a length updated by the firmware that could exceed the kernel-allocated buffer, leading to an out-of-bounds read and data leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (ret || WARN_ON_ONCE(argp->error)) goto e_free_blob;` between the header copy and the blob copy. The CVE description states: "If the failure was due to an invalid length ... copying the number of bytes _firmware_ requires will overflow the kernel-allocated buffer and leak data to userspace." The KASAN report confirms a slab-out-of-bounds read of size 2084 during `copy_to_user`.
